rows.text: In Veikune v Kingdom of Tonga (Land Court, Andrew J, LA 9/2007 and CV 301/2007; heard 30 October, decided 13 December 2007) the court records that the plaintiff, 'the HON VEIKUNE of KOLOMOTU'A', was found guilty by a jury on 25 January 2006 and, in its summary of his case, that 'He has however been deemed, under clause 23 of the Constitution to no longer be an elected representative of the Legislative Assembly of Tonga and has been removed as the Speaker'.
rows.locator: [2007] Tonga LR 207-208 (PDF pages 229-230): headnote; judgment paragraphs [1]-[3]
rows.uncertainty: A past fact stated without a day, within the court's account of the plaintiff's case; attested_on is the decision date on which the statement is observed, not a removal date. The day his office ended is taken from the PMO release (to_speaker_veikune_end_20060125), not from this judgment or from the conviction date. The title and estate issues are not imported.

bounded_scope: Speaker observations for CLAUDE-C01-24 only (role to_speaker on the to_legislative_assembly observation). Royal appointment, the Assembly's election or recommendation of its Speaker, the oath, a resignation, a revocation, an acting or interim Speaker and a Deputy Speaker presiding stay separate rows; holder observations are decided in the packet, not by any row.
